question: Which of the following functions is not controlled by the medulla oblongata?
solution:
The correct answer is __T____**o clap**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The medulla oblongata is the** lower part** of the brain.
 
• It is** tube or funnel-shaped**.
 
• Its function is to regulate breathing, heartbeat, and digestion.
 
• It connects our brain with the **spinal cord, pons, and cerebral cortex**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b9b3ceb4ec2845223ade9281a6837d6e3bcc038d4a7206f9ad2c6fbd095607a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** **__**About Human Brain**__

 
• The brain can be divided into three parts the** forebrain, the midbrain, and the hindbrain.**
 
• The brain sends and receives** chemical and electrical signals** throughout the body.
 
• It controls the **voluntary movements, and balance of the body**, (functioning of vital involuntary organs lungs, heart, and kidneys).
 
• The forebrain consists of **the cerebrum, thalamus, and hypothalamus.**
 
• The hindbrain comprises the **pons, cerebellum, and medulla.**
